title: Product-Pillar Capability Packages
brief: Define activation bundles for 4 product pillars: speed/feed (including fusion_tier routing), post-processing, print-to-program, and ERP/quote. Identify capability gaps per bundle. Define activation order and durable memory per pillar.

units.title: Define speed/feed pillar bundle with fusion_tier routing (Tier 1 empirical, Tier 2 analytical, Tier 3 FEA)
Define post-processing pillar bundle: G-code generation, verification, optimization
Define print-to-program pillar bundle: drawing interpretation, feature recognition, CAM path
Define ERP/quote pillar bundle: cost estimation, time calculation, material planning
Identify capability gaps per bundle and map to EIGC promotion decisions

exit_conditions: 4 pillar bundles fully defined with capability lists
Gaps identified and mapped to EIGC decisions
Durable memory schema defined per pillar
notes: Depends on EIGC-MS4 feature promotion decisions — bundle contents may shift based on promote/downgrade outcomes
